description_expanded: Enjoy the crisp, coastal 30A breeze from this raised three-story Inlet Beach vacation home with spacious accommodations for six happy beachgoing guests. Views of the glittering Gulf of Mexico and the sugar-white shore can be enjoyed from the balcony tops, while the beach is only an arrow’s shot away. Inlet Beach Dream has an open living, dining, and kitchen area on the second level with access to a furnished breezy balcony with gulf views. White tile flooring and sunny windows throughout accentuate a spacious look. A dove gray couch and loveseat are flanked by crystal-base table lamps around a hardwood cocktail table on a regal Persian rug. They face a large flatscreen TV for entertainment mounted above a handsome, rich burlwood cabinet. A round bamboo framed glass-top dining table nearby has matching chairs with cushioned seats and gulf views through two corner windows. The bright kitchen has a sunny window, white cabinetry, quartz countertops, and appliances. A full hall bath with a tub shower combination serves as a powder room and extra place to wash off sandy feet after some beach fun. However, the raised ground floor includes a convenient outdoor shower, along with a BBQ grill and picnic table for outdoor cookouts. The spacious primary bedroom encompasses the entire third floor. These quarters include light hardwood furnishings that feature a tropical look with a king-size bed, a flatscreen TV on a dresser, a glass table for two near a set of windows, and an ensuite bath with double vanities and a tub-shower combination. The guest bedroom is on the top floor and is furnished with the same light stylish tropical furnishings as the primary suite with a queen size bed. It also includes a private bath with a walk-in shower and a covered balcony where you may enjoy the glorious gulf views. A raised table has four chairs with colorful tropical cushions that match a charming hunter-green rocking chair. This outstanding Inlet Beach locale is close to wonderful shopping adventures and great restaurants at the swank 30Avenue . The enchanting Dutch Colonial-styled coastal village of Rosemary Beach is also nearby. It has fine restaurants with friendly bars, fashion boutiques, galleries, specialty shops, fun festivals with family amusements on the village lawns, outdoor concerts, and vibrant seasonal firework displays. Nature lovers will love Camp Helen State Park down the beach bordering a giant forested coastal dune lake treasure with fishing spots and nature trails. Besides the beautiful beach, the huge expanse of Lake Powell is the star of the show as a rare precious habitat that supports a wide array of wildlife. You may enjoy the sensational seascape on trails to explore its beauty or have a paddleboard adventure. You may see great white herons, snowy white egrets, pelicans, ducks, deer, raccoons, rabbits, and even some American bald eagles soaring overhead. Grocery stores and abundant amusements at the popular Pier Park of Panama City Beach are also just minutes away. First Floor: Entryway with Foyer. Second Floor: Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry. Third Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo. Fourth Floor: Queen Loft Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access. Rates reflect a discount for nearby construction.
